listen_addr.description: IP address the supernode binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: UDP port for incoming N2N peer connections.

network_name.description: The N2N community name (shared by all participants in the virtual network).

network_key.description: Base64-encoded shared secret for encryption (required if encryption is enabled).

enable_multicast.description: Enable multicast peer discovery (required for auto-join by new edges).

max_peers.description: Maximum number of active edge peers (0 = unlimited).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the supernode process.

bind_interface.description: Optional: Specific network interface to bind (e.g., 'eth0').

whitelist_only.description: If true, only allow edges with MACs listed in the whitelist file.

whitelist_file.description: Path to file containing allowed edge MAC addresses (one per line), used if whitelist_only=true.

forward_unknown.description: Forward traffic to unknown peers (disabled by default; may cause security issues).

registration_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for edge registration (how long until re-registration required).

edge_interfaces.description: List of TAP devices to create and configure automatically on startup (for testing/demo only; not recommended in production).

ip.description: IPv4 address assigned to the TAP device.

netmask.description: Network mask for the TAP subnet.

gateway.description: Optional gateway IP for the TAP subnet.

mtu.description: Optional MTU for the TAP device (default: 1400 to accommodate encapsulation overhead).
